text:
maya_se: Quick sync — AcmeCorp POC kickoff next week. Need final owners for infra/network, runtime readiness, and a short acceptance criteria we can share with the customer. can we confirm?
jonah_eng: I can own runtime readiness. Will validate model pinning + quant profile. ETA: Tue EOD.
tara_se: I'll own customer-facing acceptance criteria + demo script. dropping a draft here in a sec.
liam_infra: I can take infra/network. We need the customer to confirm VPN vs VPC peering today. Also need list of IPs for the dedicated pool.
evan_pm: Acceptance criteria should be explicit. Tara — can you include perf targets (p95/p99), token cost target, and a functional checklist?
maya_se: yes, perf targets from the sales side: p95 < 200ms, throughput 50 rps for demo load, and sample dataset ingestion done by Friday.
jonah_eng: Note — model variant for demo: redwood/v1-small-8bit (quant profile q4_0). Canary will fallback to redwood/v1-small-16bit if quant fails.
tara_se: Draft ACs:
- inference correctness: top-3 outputs consistent with our eval set
- perf: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 400ms under demo load
- stability: no more than 1 server OOM/60m
- ops: rollbacks tested, canary window set

liam_infra: infra checklist snippet:
```
- peering: enabled
- firewall: allow 10.0.0.0/24 -> 172.31.0.0/16
- KMS: customer key imported
- IPs: reserved pool 3.4.5.6/32
```

sam_cs: Customer confirmed peering option; they'll send network contacts. Also shared their success criteria: accuracy on their metric > 0.82 and response <= 350ms for 95% of queries.
jonah_eng: quick code/ops PR for canary config: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 — @liam_infra can you eyeball the security group rules? small change.
liam_infra: looking... will review now. expect comments by 16:00 PST.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary: infra/pr-412 — estimated start 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z :rocket:
maya_se: last ask — any blockers for Friday dry-run? if not, we tell AcmeCorp we can do demo Friday AM PST.
jonah_eng: main blocker: need sample dataset + auth token for their staging. Tara — can you nudge them for token?
tara_se: pinged them 2m ago. they replied they'll share token by EOD. will update thread.
sam_cs: token incoming, I have it. uploading to secure vault now. :white_check_mark:
maya_se: awesome. thanks everyone — will send consolidated timeline to AcmeCorp after EOD.
